title: [LOGGED OUT] Layout at tablet size 768x1024
reason: Tablet 768x1024 (Chrome mobileEmulation, iPad UA): no horizontal scroll, burger/logo/Login header OK, burger menu opens and closes

steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies or cache. Use Chrome mobileEmulation for a tablet (768x1024, DPR 2, touch, iPad UA). Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Fresh headed Chrome 900x1000 with mobileEmulation 768x1024 DPR 2, iPad user agent; innerWidth 768. /store/ loaded ('LUDUS - Official Webshop'), cookie banner shown at the bottom.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: 'How we use cookies' banner shown; clicked 'Dismiss' and it closed.

steps.text: If an "Add It to Home Screen" banner is shown at the bottom, click its X (close) button. Do not click "Claim" on that banner.
steps.saw: No 'Add It to Home Screen' banner on the page (no 'home screen' text in the DOM, none visible). Nothing clicked.

steps.text: Is the page free of horizontal scrolling (scrollWidth equals innerWidth)?
steps.saw: documentElement.scrollWidth 768, body.scrollWidth 768, innerWidth 768 (off-screen swiper slides are clipped inside their carousels).

steps.text: Are a green burger button, the LUDUS logo and a green "Login" button shown in the header?
steps.saw: Header shows burger button at x20-60 (green gradient rgb(12,150,87)->rgb(118,211,71)), LUDUS logo link at x64-164, and 'Login' button at x693-748 with the same green gradient.
Clicked the burger button; a blue menu panel slid in from the top with the LUDUS logo and a red X close button at top right; page behind dimmed.

steps.text: Does the menu show "Home", "Store", "Reward chain", "Loyalty shop" and "Login"?
steps.saw: Menu lists Home, Store (highlighted yellow), Reward chain, Loyalty shop, then a divider and Login.

steps.text: Click the red close (x) button of the menu.
steps.saw: Clicked the red X (img.burger-menu__close-button at top right); the menu panel went away.
Menu panel no longer visible; menu links moved off-screen (left -748) and close button at x -36. Store page with burger, logo and Login header shown normally; scrollWidth still 768.
